judgments.reason: A 2026 scoping review of 46 machine learning studies that use the AHEPA dataset. It analyzes work on this dataset but does not introduce or release the data.
judgments.paper_title: The AHEPA EEG benchmark: setting the standard for machine learning in dementia diagnosis, a scoping review
